Name: Secret Woods Extra Area
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[size=6][color=#ffff00][b]Secret Woods Extra Area[/b][/color][/size]
Explore beyond the Secret Woods and discover three outdoor areas and a hidden cavern!
Collect hardwood and seasonal forage, find new fishing spots, gather iridium ore, or grow crops and fruit trees in a quiet part of the forest.
The outdoor areas feature the ambient lighting, floating particles, drifting leaves, and music of the vanilla Secret Woods, helping them feel like a natural extension of the original location.

[size=5][color=#00ffff][b]Locations & Features[/b][/color][/size]
[b]Secret Woods Lakeside[/b]
The main area can be reached from the northern part of the vanilla Secret Woods. Explore the lake and waterfalls, collect seasonal forage, and harvest hardwood from six respawning stumps.
A configurable minecart provides convenient travel once the vanilla minecart network is unlocked and you have visited Secret Woods Lakeside at least once. An optional bridge lets you reach the minecart without dismounting from your horse.

[b]Secret Woods Cavern[/b]
A cavern hidden behind the waterfall opens once the bus is repaired. You can also unlock it early through the mod settings.
One Iridium Node is generated each day, providing a small, steady source of iridium ore without having to venture into Skull Cavern. The cavern has its own fishing selection, including cave fish and Cave Jelly.
With Seasonal Fish enabled, you can also catch the following fish:
- Summer: Lava Eel
- Fall: Void Salmon
- Winter: Ice Pip
The water surface color changes with the seasons when this option is enabled. Sunlight inside the cavern also changes with the time of day and weather.
You can enter and leave the cavern while riding your horse.

[b]Secret Woods Depths[/b]
This secluded area can be reached from the upper-right corner of Secret Woods Lakeside. It normally opens once the greenhouse is repaired, but it can also be unlocked early through the mod settings.
Between 6 and 12 weeds are set to spawn each day, providing an additional source of fiber. You can also enjoy fishing in the pools around the waterfalls.

[b]Secret Woods – Foot of the Great Tree[/b]
Located to the right of Secret Woods Lakeside, this area features a small farming plot beneath a great tree, four respawning hardwood stumps, and seasonal forage and flowers.
You can choose regular farm rules or greenhouse growing conditions for the farming area. With greenhouse rules enabled, the surrounding trees, bushes, and tilled soil still retain their seasonal appearance.
An optional tent allows you to sleep, end the day, and save your game without returning to the farmhouse.

[size=5][color=#00ffff][b]Configuration (GMCM)[/b][/color][/size]
Customize the mod through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url].
- Enable or disable the mod.
- Adjust the saturation of the custom tilesheet to better match recolor mods (Vanilla, -30%, or -50%).
- Enable or disable the minecart and bridge at Secret Woods Lakeside.
- Unlock Secret Woods Cavern and Secret Woods Depths early.
- Enable or disable seasonal fish and their corresponding water colors in the cavern.
- Choose the farming type at the Foot of the Great Tree.
- Show or hide the tent.

[b]Farming Type[/b]
- Farm (default): Grow crops and fruit trees under normal farm rules.
- Greenhouse (Dirt Only): Grow crops and fruit trees year-round, with fruit tree planting restricted to dirt tiles.
- Greenhouse (All Ground Types): Grow crops and fruit trees year-round, with no ground-type restriction on fruit tree planting.
Normal planting restrictions, such as obstacles and spacing between fruit trees, still apply.

[b]Reset Bushes[/b]
The mod's GMCM menu includes a Reset Bushes button powered by T's Core. It removes bushes from all three outdoor areas and regenerates them based on the current map data.
Use this after a mod update if the bush layout has changed. This feature is available to the host after loading a save, and does not require enabling T's Core's own Terrain Features menu or Shortcut Panel.
[b]Note:[/b] The Seasonal Fish setting should be changed from the title screen, as changes made during gameplay may not take effect immediately.

[size=5][color=#00ffff][b]Requirements[/b][/color][/size]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- [size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50043]T's Core[/url] 2.1.1 or later[/size]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager (FTM)[/url] (required for the included resource and forage spawning content pack)
Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) is optional but recommended for changing settings in-game.

[size=5][color=#00ffff][b]Installation[/b][/color][/size]
Install the required mods, then extract the downloaded archive into your Stardew Valley Mods folder. Keep both the [CP] and [FTM] content packs to enjoy all the features described above.
If you are updating from an older version, replace the old content pack folders with the new ones. After loading your save, you can use Reset Bushes in the mod's GMCM menu if the bushes no longer match the updated maps.

[size=5][color=#00ffff][b]Compatibility[/b][/color][/size]
Includes dedicated support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url], with an adjusted entrance to Secret Woods Lakeside.
The following mods were also supported in previous versions:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2571]DeepWoods[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13497]Stardew Valley Reimagined 3[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2364]Even More Secret Woods[/url]

[size=5][color=#00ffff][b]Languages[/b][/color][/size]
Currently supports English, Japanese, French, Brazilian Portuguese, and Russian.
